name: Michigan Food Equipment Co
old_description: • Experience Cutting-Edge technology  that revolutionizes Bacon slicing with  unmatched accuracy.
about:
Michigan Food Equipment Co is based in Howell, Michigan. The company's founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed. It operates as a manufacturer of food processing equipment, with a focus on bacon slicing and interleaving systems.

The company designs and builds the Razorback line of industrial bacon slicers and paper interleavers. Its slicers feature variable blade speeds up to 1,650 rpm and claim production rates up to 4,000 pounds per hour, with thickness regulation and waste-slice elimination. Michigan Food Equipment also rebuilds used industrial meat packaging equipment and manufactures replacement parts in-house, including components for Anco presses and slicers.

The equipment serves meat and food processing plants, particularly bacon and sliced-meat producers. Customers include operations seeking to integrate slicing and interleaving into existing production lines, as well as those needing rebuilt machinery or spare parts for legacy Anco systems.

The company emphasizes domestic parts manufacturing and the ability to service equipment worldwide, positioning itself as a single source for both new machinery and ongoing support.
